fusions.name: Pile On
fusions.desc: Bowls through a cone 3 tiles ahead and deals 14 damage, leaving every enemy hit [Stunned] for 1.2 seconds. It grows 8% stronger for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Bait the Great
fusions.desc: Hangs off the target for 30 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Rear Up
fusions.desc: Raises your maximum health by 20% for 15 seconds, and pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Thick Ruff
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
